title: Figure 8: Laser-Based Chronograph for Measuring Hypersonic Aircraft Velocity
description: Schematic of a test range in which a yellow 'Hypersonic Aircraft' passes through two vertical 'Laser Beams' from 'Lasers' separated by distance L and sensed by 'Photodetectors'. Signals feed a 'Storage Oscilloscope' whose trace shows two peaks separated by Δt, leading to 'Velocity = L/Δt'.
